description: The plot illustrates the relationship between a parameter N and AUC (Area Under the Curve), expressed as a percentage. The x-axis is labeled “N” and ranges from 0 to 20 with a linear scale and tick marks every 5 units. The y-axis is labeled “AUC (%)” with a linear scale ranging from 75 to 100 and tick marks every 5 units. A blue line with circle markers begins at approximately 94.5% at N=0 and increases to approximately 97.5% at N=20, displaying a general upward trend. An orange line with square markers starts at approximately 84% at N=0 and rises to approximately 94% at N=20, also representing an increasing trend. A green line with star markers starts at approximately 86% at N=0 and increases to around 93% at N=20, showing consistent growth. A purple line with downward-pointing triangle markers begins at approximately 78% at N=0, drops sharply to approximately 80% at N=5, then decreases to approximately 84% at N=20. Finally, a light blue line with circle markers begins at approximately 95% at N=0 and decreases to approximately 92% at N=20, showing a gradual decline.
